resources.string: Press a button to launch the ball.
Press A to begin, or B to jump straight to the higher level. Start pauses.
A to play again, B to play again at the higher level.
Select (−): back to the game list.
Nintendo controllers: swap A and B
Android puts A at the bottom and B on the right, the opposite of Nintendo. When on, the app’s A and B buttons are the ones printed on the controller.
